taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key terms from PA NS1 | Nervous System & Eye.

words.clue: Inflammation of the membranes surrounding the brain and spinal cord.
Most common route by which organisms spread from blood to meninges.
Type of exudate containing pus in bacterial meningitis that appears cloudy.
Lymphocytic meningitis caused by viral pathogens with clear CSF.
Polysaccharide structure on bacteria that resists phagocytosis and enables meningitis.
Most common and lethal form of bacterial meningitis in adults.
Bacterial meningitis presenting with petechial rash and Waterhouse-Friderichsen syndrome.
Fluid accumulation in the subarachnoid space during meningitis.
Inflammation of meningeal and cortical blood vessels causing infarction.
Communicating condition caused by obstruction of CSF flow in meningitis.
Dominant white blood cells found in purulent meningitis exudate.
Space between arachnoid and pia mater where meningitis exudate accumulates.
